limitations: Texture-only candidate. No source geometry, footprint, terrain, collision, roofs or other buildings changed.
Marble panel joints, opening/frame widths and simple glass interiors are approximate original authoring based on the opened architectural references, not a measured reconstruction.

1016-18 central bank remains source pixels at H[2.2,4.95]. The two expanded lower entrance columns remain source pixels only at H[-5.8,1.7]; no hidden door is invented. Native runtime-views-v2 exposed original photographed foliage at their base. The bounded H[1.7,2.2] band now uses the existing same-building granite donor from page 1013/chart 1013-0, keeping the same exact chart and along-column bounds. Ground-only final HCOL minima 1.80011 and 2.09368 bury the reconstruction bottom by at least 0.10 m. Exact source UV corners and final support samples are recorded in visible-base-materials-cpu-v1.json (SHA256 91cf900b115dce7d4d84654e6974d8c5cbd5bd728ae1425600169d0e0a63606a). Native compressed review is required after this material correction.
